headline: Vijayalakshmi Jayaraman Iyer appointed deputy CHRO of Hubtown
summary: Real estate company Hubtown has appointed Vijayalakshmi Jayaraman Iyer as its new Deputy Chief Human Resources Officer. She joins the firm from Securities, where she spent over three years as CHRO, bringing nearly two decades of human resources experience. Throughout her career, Iyer has held strategic HR roles at several organizations, including an 11-year tenure at Nirmal Lifestyle.

headline: SAP expands AI skilling drive in India
summary: Enterprise software leader SAP has announced initiatives to equip two million people in India with AI skills by 2030 as part of its broader global training goal. The company is collaborating with government bodies, universities, and industry partners to offer targeted learning, certifications, and career pathways for students, professionals, and underserved communities. To date, nearly 13 percent of the target audience in India has already participated in SAP's skill development programs.

headline: Case-in-Point: The CEO succession shadow
summary: After appointing new board members focused on digital transformation, Orion Manufacturing quietly initiated an external search for its next CEO despite having previously promised the role to its current COO. The company's CHRO now faces an ethical dilemma regarding whether to preserve board confidentiality or inform the executive that his succession is being reconsidered.

headline: Amazon refocuses AI use on real value
summary: Amazon has issued internal guidance directing its software engineers to prioritize business outcomes and customer value over raw AI usage metrics. The policy discourages 'tokenmaxxing,' a wasteful practice where high volumes of AI resources are consumed without generating measurable improvements in work quality. Ultimately, the company aims to promote responsible, cost-effective technology adoption that balances AI tools with human judgment.

headline: Leadership transition at the Tata Group: Noel Tata to step back
summary: In accordance with the company's retirement policy for non-executive directors, Noel Tata will step down from six key Tata Group boards on his 70th birthday while retaining his role as a nominee director at Tata Sons. This major leadership transition underscores the critical need for structured succession planning to maintain governance stability and operational continuity across large, diversified conglomerates.

headline: Škoda Auto’s LGBTQ+ employee network marks 5 years amid wider inclusion efforts
summary: Škoda Auto's LGBTQ+ employee network, Škoda Proud, is celebrating its five-year anniversary after expanding to over 200 members and hosting more than 30 inclusion events over the past year. In recognition of these initiatives, the automaker earned a gold award in the LGBTQ+ Friendly Employer 2026 programme by the Pride Business Forum. The milestone reflects Škoda's broader commitment to workplace diversity, alongside other internal networks and cross-industry collaborations across the Volkswagen Group.

headline: Bajaj Finserv elevates Amit Sharma as senior head-HR, L&D and admin
summary: Bajaj Finserv has elevated Amit Sharma to Senior Head of HR, Learning & Development, and Administration for the Microfinance strategic business unit of Bajaj Finance. Sharma brings over 20 years of human resources experience, including previous leadership roles at Jio, Bharti Infratel, and various Bajaj group entities. In his new role, he will oversee strategic HR planning, talent management, and administrative operations for the unit.

headline: HR Perspectives by Arindam Chakraborty: “Succession planning must begin two to three levels below the target role”
summary: Arindam Chakraborty, CHRO of Saatvik Green Energy, emphasizes that succession planning in fast-scaling manufacturing environments must begin two to three levels below critical roles. To support rapid facility expansion and retain specialized talent, the company focuses on identifying leadership potential up to 18 months in advance and mapping distinct career pathways. This proactive approach ensures the internal talent pipeline keeps pace with operational growth while aligning HR directly with business outcomes.

headline: 26% frontline employees report negative transformation experiences, nearly 3x the senior management rate
summary: A recent Edelman report reveals a significant disconnect between executives and frontline staff regarding major workplace changes like AI rollouts and restructurings. While only 9% of senior management reported negative transformation experiences, 26% of non-management employees did, citing added workloads without extra pay as the primary driver. The findings suggest that strategic realignments celebrating efficiency at the top often translate into operational strain for the employees implementing them.

headline: Noise & Gaana launch Buds R1 with one-year Gaana Plus subscription
summary: Noise and audio streaming platform Gaana have launched the co-branded Noise Buds R1 wireless earbuds, priced at Rs 1,399 and bundled with a complimentary one-year Gaana Plus subscription. The earbuds offer up to 40 hours of playtime, fast-charging capabilities, and quad microphones with Environmental Noise Cancellation. As part of a broader strategic partnership, the companies plan to bundle Gaana subscriptions across Noise's product portfolio to reach 2.5 million consumers by 2026.
